/careers.title: Join the Team | Super Conscious
/careers.description: Join a small team of strategists, creatives, and builders. Everyone is close to the work. Philadelphia, PA.

/contact.title: Start a Project | Super Conscious
/contact.description: Tell us where you are and what you're trying to accomplish. We'll respond within one business day.

/lp/brand-consistency-across-a-team.title: Brand Consistency Across a Team | Super Conscious
/lp/brand-consistency-across-a-team.description: Brand consistency is a tooling problem, not a documentation one. Give the team shared templates and clear decision rules, not a PDF in a shared drive.
/lp/brand-consistency-across-a-team.ogTitle: Brand Consistency Across a Team | Super Conscious

/lp/brand-guidelines-vs-brand-system.title: Brand Guidelines vs. Brand System | Super Conscious
/lp/brand-guidelines-vs-brand-system.description: Brand guidelines are a document. A brand system adds the templates, components, and training that turn those rules into work your team can produce.
/lp/brand-guidelines-vs-brand-system.ogTitle: Brand Guidelines vs. Brand System | Super Conscious

/lp/brand-or-content-first.title: What comes first: brand or content? | Super Conscious
/lp/brand-or-content-first.description: Brand first. Content made before your positioning and voice are set is content you will redo. If you are already in market, the two can run in parallel.
/lp/brand-or-content-first.ogTitle: What comes first: brand or content? | Super Conscious

/lp/brand-system-cost.title: How much does a brand system cost? | Super Conscious
/lp/brand-system-cost.description: $25,000–$80,000 for a brand system, from an early-stage identity system up to a full brand platform. Strategy is included at every level.
/lp/brand-system-cost.ogTitle: How much does a brand system cost? | Super Conscious

/lp/content-program-cost.title: How much does a content program cost? | Super Conscious
/lp/content-program-cost.description: Priced monthly, $8,000–$25,000 for a B2B content program. Volume, formats, and how much of the strategy and editorial work you handle set the number.
/lp/content-program-cost.ogTitle: How much does a content program cost? | Super Conscious

/lp/creative-studio-vs-freelancer.title: Creative Studio vs. Freelancer | Super Conscious
/lp/creative-studio-vs-freelancer.description: A freelancer fits contained, well-defined work. A creative studio makes sense when strategy, design, writing, and production need one accountable team.
/lp/creative-studio-vs-freelancer.ogTitle: Creative Studio vs. Freelancer | Super Conscious

/lp/design-system-vs-brand-system.title: Design System vs. Brand System | Super Conscious
/lp/design-system-vs-brand-system.description: A design system is the components and tokens engineers build interfaces with. A brand system reaches wider, across identity, voice, and every surface.
/lp/design-system-vs-brand-system.ogTitle: Design System vs. Brand System | Super Conscious

/lp/do-i-need-a-brand-system-before-cont.title: Brand System Before Content Marketing? | Super Conscious
/lp/do-i-need-a-brand-system-before-cont.description: No, not a full brand system. Content does need the basics settled first: what you stand for, who you are talking to, and how you want to sound.
/lp/do-i-need-a-brand-system-before-cont.ogTitle: Brand System Before Content Marketing? | Super Conscious

/lp/how-long-does-a-brand-system-take.title: How long does a brand system take? | Super Conscious
/lp/how-long-does-a-brand-system-take.description: Most brand system engagements run 8–12 weeks: 3–4 on discovery and strategy, 5–8 on design and build. Scope and your team's review speed set the range.
/lp/how-long-does-a-brand-system-take.ogTitle: How long does a brand system take? | Super Conscious

/lp/how-long-to-design-a-web-app.title: How long does it take to design a web app? | Super Conscious
/lp/how-long-to-design-a-web-app.description: The app's user types and core flows set the range. Most web apps take 8–16 weeks, with research and definition claiming the first 3–4 of them.
/lp/how-long-to-design-a-web-app.ogTitle: How long does it take to design a web app? | Super Conscious

/lp/how-long-until-content-marketing-wor.title: How Long Until Content Marketing Works | Super Conscious
/lp/how-long-until-content-marketing-wor.description: Expect roughly six months before content marketing compounds and twelve before it sustains itself. Month three, where most companies quit, is too early.
/lp/how-long-until-content-marketing-wor.ogTitle: How Long Until Content Marketing Works | Super Conscious

/lp/how-much-does-product-design-cost.title: How much does product design cost? | Super Conscious
/lp/how-much-does-product-design-cost.description: Product design runs $40,000–$150,000, from a 6–8 week sprint on a single flow to a 4–6 month engagement with research and a design system.
/lp/how-much-does-product-design-cost.ogTitle: How much does product design cost? | Super Conscious

/lp/how-to-build-a-b2b-content-program.title: How to Build a B2B Content Program | Super Conscious
/lp/how-to-build-a-b2b-content-program.description: Audience and point of view come before the calendar. The B2B content programs that last are built on what buyers are trying to figure out.
/lp/how-to-build-a-b2b-content-program.ogTitle: How to Build a B2B Content Program | Super Conscious

/lp/how-to-measure-a-content-program.title: How do you measure a content program? | Super Conscious
/lp/how-to-measure-a-content-program.description: Traffic and rankings show a content program is building reach; pipeline influence and sourced revenue show it drives business. Pageviews measure neither.
/lp/how-to-measure-a-content-program.ogTitle: How do you measure a content program? | Super Conscious

/lp/what-does-a-brand-system-include.title: What does a brand system actually include? | Super Conscious
/lp/what-does-a-brand-system-include.description: Visual identity, messaging, voice, and the tools that keep a team consistent without asking a designer every time. A brand system covers all four.
/lp/what-does-a-brand-system-include.ogTitle: What does a brand system actually include? | Super Conscious

/lp/what-does-a-digital-product-design-e.title: What a Product Design Engagement Includes | Super Conscious
/lp/what-does-a-digital-product-design-e.description: User research, interaction design, visual design, and a design system your engineers build from. Engagement scope depends on whether the product exists.
/lp/what-does-a-digital-product-design-e.ogTitle: What a Product Design Engagement Includes | Super Conscious

/lp/what-is-a-content-program.title: What is a content program? | Super Conscious
/lp/what-is-a-content-program.description: Publishing is an activity. A content program is infrastructure: an ongoing system with a strategy, a cadence, a voice, formats, and a way to measure it.
/lp/what-is-a-content-program.ogTitle: What is a content program? | Super Conscious

/lp/what-is-a-thought-leadership-program.title: What is a thought leadership program? | Super Conscious
/lp/what-is-a-thought-leadership-program.description: A thought leadership program builds a company or founder's reputation as a serious voice in their category. The goal is credibility, not traffic.
/lp/what-is-a-thought-leadership-program.ogTitle: What is a thought leadership program? | Super Conscious

/lp/what-is-a-verbal-identity.title: What is a verbal identity? | Super Conscious
/lp/what-is-a-verbal-identity.description: The words you use, the words you avoid, and how you sound in writing. Verbal identity does for language what a visual identity does for design.
/lp/what-is-a-verbal-identity.ogTitle: What is a verbal identity? | Super Conscious

/lp/what-to-ask-a-creative-agency.title: What to Ask a Creative Agency | Super Conscious
/lp/what-to-ask-a-creative-agency.description: Ask a creative agency what it believes that most agencies do not, and how it handles disagreement with a client. The answers matter more than the work.
/lp/what-to-ask-a-creative-agency.ogTitle: What to Ask a Creative Agency | Super Conscious

/lp/what-to-look-for-in-a-product-design.title: Choosing a Product Design Studio | Super Conscious
/lp/what-to-look-for-in-a-product-design.description: Strategy, not just craft. A product design studio worth hiring can walk you through why it made each decision and how the design performed.
/lp/what-to-look-for-in-a-product-design.ogTitle: Choosing a Product Design Studio | Super Conscious

/lp/when-to-invest-in-a-brand-system.title: When to Invest in a Brand System | Super Conscious
/lp/when-to-invest-in-a-brand-system.description: Invest once inconsistency has a real cost, whether that is time recreating assets, trust with buyers, or growth as you hire, raise, or expand.
/lp/when-to-invest-in-a-brand-system.ogTitle: When to Invest in a Brand System | Super Conscious
